name: Hora, Autumn
body:
AUTUMN HORA
CR 6

This beautiful woman dances among the falling leaves without leaving a trace; her hair, skin, and eyes match the green, gold, brown, and red of the autumn trees, as do the veils she wears.

XP 2,400
CG Medium fey
Init +8; Senses low-light vision; Perception +16
Aura stunning beauty (30 ft., DC 19)

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 15, flat-footed 14 (+4 Dex, +1 dodge, +4 natural)
hp 65 (10d6+30)
Fort +6, Ref +11, Will +10; +4 vs. energy drain and negative energy effects
DR 5/cold iron
Weaknesses autumn bound

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee autumn sickle +9 (3d6+3 slashing +1d6 negative energy)
Ranged ray of decay +9 (4d8 negative energy)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 10th; concentration +14)

Constant—speak with animals, speak with plants
At will—know direction, pass without trace, purify food and drink
1/day—animal messenger, bestow curse (DC 18), commune with nature, faerie fire, goodberry

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 19, Con 16, Int 15, Wis 17, Cha 18
Base Atk +5; CMB +6, CMD 21
Feats Combat Casting, Dodge, Improved Initiative, Mobility, Weapon Finesse
Skills Acrobatics +17, Diplomacy +17, Escape Artist +17, Knowledge (nature) +15, Perception +16, Sense Motive +16, Stealth +17, Survival +13
Languages Common, Elven, Sylvan; speak with animals, speak with plants
SQ autumn’s acquittal

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate forests
Organization solitary or chorus (2-12)
Treasure standard (autumn sickle, other treasure)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Autumn Bound (Su)

During spring months, the autumn hora gains the sickened condition.

Autumn’s Acquittal (Su)

As an immediate action after an autumn hora or an ally within 30 feet of the hora that it can see fails a saving throw, the hora grants an enhancement bonus to the saving throw based on the time of year. The bonus is +4 during the month of the autumnal equinox, +2 during the month before or after the autumnal equinox, and +1 during any time other than the vernal equinox month, during which this ability doesn’t function. The autumn hora can’t use this ability again for 1d4 rounds.

Stunning Beauty (Su)

This ability affects all humanoids within 30 feet of the autumn hora. Those who look directly at the hora must succeed on a DC 19 Fortitude save or be stunned for 1 minute and staggered for 1 hour. The hora can suppress or resume this ability as a free action. The save DC is Charisma-based.

ABOUT

The Horai in the Greek myth were nymphs who danced around the Sun’s chariot, representing the seasons of the year and the hours of the day (the word “hour” derives from the Ancient Greek and Latin Hora). There were most commonly three of them: Thallo, Auxo, and Carpo (“Bloom” for Spring, “Increaser” for Summer, and “Reaper of Fruits” for Autumn). In other versions, they were the embodiment of the good effects of law and order (symbolized by Apollo) on the world of mortals, and their names were Eunomia (“Good Governance”), Dike (“Justice”), and Eirene (“Peace”). In Pathfinder’s rules, the stats for the Summer Hora and the Summer Hora Queen were given in the Faerie Bestiary: here we present horai for the remaining three seasons, and their respective Queens. Maybe the nymphs of Order could be discussed in a future issue of this magazine?
